paragraphs.text: Pontotoc’s Oct. 26–31 athletics schedule brings soccer, junior-high basketball and a Saturday state cross-country meet, but families should confirm two entries before making plans. The new Pontotoc Athletics weekly graphic and the district’s event calendar disagree on Monday’s basketball opponent and Thursday’s junior-varsity soccer start time.

Both sources list junior-high basketball at 5 p.m. Monday, Oct. 26. The weekly graphic names Amory, while the district calendar says “JH BB VS. SOUTH” at home. The district office’s published number is 662-489-3336 for families seeking confirmation.

The two sources agree on Tuesday’s soccer game against Houston at 5 p.m.; the district calendar places that game at home. Junior-high basketball travels to Guntown on Thursday, Oct. 29, for a 5 p.m. start.

Thursday also includes JV soccer against Oxford at home. The weekly graphic lists 5 p.m., but the district’s event page lists 7 p.m. Supporters should check with the school before traveling rather than assume either published time has been confirmed.

Saturday, Oct. 31, has two 10 a.m. listings: state cross-country in Clinton and a basketball jamboree at home. The notices do not identify individual cross-country race assignments or the jamboree opponents.

All times above are local Central Daylight Time. The original weekly schedule and district event entries are linked below, along with our earlier football preview covering Oct. 30 senior night. This roundup reports the published schedule rather than game results.
